sources.note: Phone connector article (opened): the 3.5 mm (1/8 in, "mini") plug has a 3.5 mm sleeve diameter and a plug length of 15 mm. The model is the TRS plug shape drawn at that size (tip features and boot lengths scaled by 0.5). ESTIMATES: handle 7 mm diameter and 40 mm overall length (typical moulded mini plug), the position of the two insulator bands (scaled from the 6.35 mm plug).
